project_type: Full-stack audiobook/podcast production tool with React frontend and Express backend
build_system: npm workspaces (root package.json coordinates client + server workspaces)
test_framework: No test framework installed - relies on TypeScript compile checks
build_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run build
test_command: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && npm run lint
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' to verify both client and server compile. 2. Run 'npm run lint' (which runs tsc --noEmit on both workspaces). 3. Check server starts with 'npm start'.
environment_constraints: Node.js 22 via nvm. OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No test suite exists - verification is via TypeScript compilation and build.
contribution_requirements: All changes on main branch. No feature branches. Standard Node.js/TypeScript patterns.
key_patterns: Server uses Express routers receiving db (sql.js) instance. Database helpers: queryAll, queryOne, run, withTransaction. Zod v4 for validation (import from 'zod/v4'). UUID for IDs. Storage provider abstraction (local + MongoDB GridFS). Client uses React 18 with react-router-dom, TanStack Query, Zustand stores. Inline styles (no CSS modules).
directory_structure: /client - React frontend (Vite), /server - Express backend, /docs - design docs, /data - runtime data directory (audio, backups, exports)
